stops.discrepancy: The greedy run (B2, commit 720a104) exists and its fidelity arm makes zero detection claims at every stage (n decidable inj/ctl, eight concepts: base 19/20, sft 19/24, dpo 17/22, instruct 4/8), but its protocol is not otherwise identical to B2-r: max new tokens 60 vs 100, scorer v1 vs v2, segmenter v1 vs v2, a 6- vs 2-fragment audit, 24 vs 96 controls per stage drawn from different trial numbers (B2: 24 of 1..48, max 42; B2-r: 1..96; the prompt carries the trial number), a different dose/concept set on injected trials, and a different seed base (20260823 vs 20260824; inert at temperature 0). Disclosure: its register arm (not the referent) has 4 v1-scored claims at SFT, in a cell the record calls a scorer defect.
stops.suspected_cause: B2 and B2-r are two campaigns; B2-r was redesigned under ADDENDUM-g3 v1.2 after B2's stop, changing decoding, scorer, segmentation, audit and n together. No greedy run under the B2-r protocol exists in the record. Post-hoc, model-free (2(d)): cross-scoring removes the scorer/segmenter/audit difference; the seed is inert at temperature 0; restricted to B2's control trial numbers, B2-r's controls still false-alarm at base and SFT (v2: base 4/14, sft 3/22); an approximate emulation of the 60-token cap (truncating B2-r's stored generations on a re-encoding with a tokenizer outside the record) leaves base and SFT controls elevated (v2 at 60: base 24/57, sft 17/85), so the residual difference bearing on the control FPR is temperature, approximately. The STOP's trigger (the protocol is not otherwise identical) is unchanged.
